description: Update fields of an existing Asana task.

assignee_gid.description: Optional unique identifier (gid) of the user to reassign the task to.

completed.description: Optional completion state to set: true marks the task completed, false marks it incomplete.

due_on.description: Optional new due date for the task, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name.description: Optional new name for the task; omitted fields are left unchanged.

notes.description: Optional new notes for the task; omitted fields are left unchanged.

task_gid.description: The unique identifier (gid) of the task to update.

name: update_task
